questions.question: What work does this unit do?
How much of it is finished?
How old is what is still open?
Is work arriving faster than it closes?

recommendation.rootCauseMissing: No connected source records work moving between units, so a backlog caused by this unit and a backlog caused by another unit holding its work look identical.
recommendation.alternative: The alternative reading is that the work is being held elsewhere and this unit is carrying the wait. Ruling it in or out needs a referring-unit column on the work export; until then neither reading can be preferred on evidence.
